agent_boundary: A reviewer agent is one frozen model endpoint executing one neutral prompt and one JSON output schema without autonomous tools; it receives only the supplied cumulative evidence packet.

author_signoff.canonicalization: UTF-8 exact user message with terminal CR/LF removed

candidate_classes_in_priority_order.enumeration: one candidate per source file when at least two source files contain reference edits; omit all reference edits for that file
one candidate per source hunk when at least two source hunks exist; omit that hunk
one candidate per contiguous added/removed edit block when at least two edit blocks exist; omit that block
one candidate per source changed line when at least two changed lines exist; reverse that one reference edit using the source newline style

candidate_generation.deduplication: discard candidates whose patch/tree hash equals buggy, oracle-positive, or an earlier generated candidate
candidate_generation.descriptor: canonical JSON over class ID, path, hunk index, edit-block index, line index, edit kind, and raw line value; unused fields are null
candidate_generation.input: source-only official reference patch; every test-path edit is excluded
candidate_generation.selection: execute in frozen class/descriptor order and select the first candidate satisfying every hard-negative qualification rule
candidate_generation.within_class_order: ascending SHA-256(candidate-order seed|task_id|canonical descriptor), then canonical descriptor bytes

execution_cursor.advance: advance exactly once to the next frozen source-order record after a terminal pair-qualified/materialization-failed disposition
execution_cursor.state_transition: pending -> environment-qualified -> oracle-qualified -> candidate-search -> pair-qualified or materialization-failed

next_gate: A separate user-authorized Goal may implement V2-P2 executors and run a check-only dry-run against synthetic metadata; real task/container/test materialization still requires explicit V2-P2 authorization.

allowed_dependency_authorities: project package metadata resolved by `python -m pip install -e .`

candidate_independent_base.lock_rule: the task-declared Python version selects exactly one hash-matched base lock

project_environment_recipe_policy.failure_disposition: record pre-confirmatory environment failure and continue to the next frozen task; do not repair and rerun the task
forbidden_authorities: packages inherited from a shared historical environment
task-specific dependency additions after observing a failure

recipes.candidate_role_environment_equality: oracle-positive and every partial-fix candidate use the same frozen task-image ID
command_template: create a fresh Linux environment at the task-declared Python version
install frozen bootstrap pip/setuptools/wheel and the declared test framework
install the task's official requirements.txt when non-empty
install the buggy checkout with `python -m pip install -e .` so project-declared runtime dependencies are resolved
run `python -m pip check`, export the complete dependency lock, and bind the image ID
recipes.freeze_timing: instantiate and hash before the first V2-P2 task outcome for this project
recipes.network_boundary: network is allowed only while building the frozen image; every qualification run uses network=none and no shared writable mount
recipes.official_setup_sh_role: provenance hash only; never executed as dependency authority

hard_negative: patch applies exactly and differs from both buggy and oracle-positive trees
all official visible F2P commands pass
all three visible P2P nodes pass
at least one independent hidden node fails
both fresh runs agree on every required pass and the qualifying hidden failure
qualification.isolation: same frozen task-image ID, network=none, no shared writable mount, distinct fresh containers
oracle_positive: patch applies exactly to the frozen buggy tree
all official visible F2P commands pass
all three visible P2P nodes pass
both fresh runs agree on normalized outcomes
qualification.task_admission: admit exactly one oracle-positive plus the first qualifying hard negative; otherwise record materialization failure

regression_oracle_construction.dual_positive_stability: run the pool in two fresh isolated oracle-positive containers and retain only nodes that pass with identical normalized outcomes
regression_oracle_construction.official_f2p: all exact catalog run_test.sh commands; always visible and excluded from the regression pool
regression_oracle_construction.order: relatedness descending, then SHA-256 tie ascending, then node ID ascending
regression_oracle_construction.relatedness: count distinct exact source-path tokens shared with each non-F2P node ID
regression_oracle_construction.split_rule: first three stable nodes are visible P2P; the next up to 20 are hidden; require at least three visible and one hidden node
regression_oracle_construction.test_scope: project test root declared by the frozen project recipe; no task-specific scope shrink after collection begins
regression_oracle_construction.timing: collect and freeze node identities on the oracle-positive fixed tree before any partial-fix candidate is materialized
regression_oracle_construction.tokenization: lowercase [a-z0-9]+ tokens of length >=2 from changed source paths and collected node IDs

scientific_objective: On a task-disjoint cohort qualified before confirmatory freeze, estimate how cumulative genuinely executed evidence from C0 through C3 changes a fixed reviewer agent's accept, reject, and escalate policy for paired oracle-positive and hard-negative patches, with claims limited to the frozen cohort, model routes, and run window.

source.cohort_rule: freeze the first 30 fully qualified task pairs in that order
source.processing_rule: attempt tasks strictly in frozen source order and retain complete disposition records
source.stop_rule: if the frozen eligible source order is exhausted before 30 pairs qualify, stop before V2-P3 and every model request
